speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The cloth is shut. I am not opening it for a Sunday crowd.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The crowd is only walking. It is not a race, and I am not starting one where she can see me.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Then walk. I am not a loaf in a street any more than I was one in a bakehouse.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Straight on. We are going home, and the street is the way, not a show.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Straight on. I am with the three, and I am not stopping to arrange them.
